__note: Keyed map for GET /api/v4/entity/AuditInspection/fetch/{RowUID}. The mock looks up the trailing RowUID path param and returns the matching value (which has the shape { Entity: {...} }). Question fields consumed: Answer ('0'==unacceptable), Verification (deficiency text), FileAttachments[0].{AttachmentUID,FileName}. Entity fields consumed: RowUID, FormNumber, BusinessEntity, QuestionsSelector, UpdatedDtm, RecurringTaskCompleteDtm, Questions.
